message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2-defining SNP) in Europeans**

| Source | Frequency (C allele) |
|--------|----------------------|
| 1000 Genomes Project (EUR panel) | ~0.13–0.15 |
| gnomAD v2.1.1 (European ancestry) | ~0.12–0.14 |

In other words, roughly **12 – 15 %** of European chromosomes carry the rs7412 allele (the “ε2” allele). This estimate is consistent across most European sub‑populations, though some regional differences exist (e.g., slightly higher frequencies in Southern Europe and lower in Northern Scandinavia).
